productionBundle.note: Live Netlify still serves Phase 22 bundle index-Cu_7jFHY.js — NOT Phase 25 (c532201). User claim that production includes Phase 25 is contradicted by live HTML.

classificationDetail.A_expected_unauth_fallback: PARTIAL — local fallback is intentional AFTER write failure, but client keeps retrying protected mutations
classificationDetail.B_retry_polling_loop: YES — Command Center 5s refresh + reactive feed + persist→push retries
classificationDetail.D_notification_polling_loop: YES — event-driven hydrate on every workflow-tasks-updated (not a fixed interval poller)
classificationDetail.E_workflow_task_creation_loop: YES — pushStoreToApi POSTs tasks whenever local store changes
classificationDetail.F_threat_feedback_loop: AMPLIFIER — observes failures and POSTs security events; does not initiate workflow writes
classificationDetail.G_missing_auth_contract: YES — writes require Admin Bearer; frontend workflowFetch sends no Authorization
classificationDetail.H_interacting_problems: YES — auth gap + availability mis-signal + refresh cadence + notification hydrate coupling + threat scoring

rootCause.initiatingTrigger: syncWorkflowTasks via buildCommandCenterSnapshot / StudioWorkspaceLayout + ProductionCommandCenter 5s refresh and reactive $: feedReels
mechanism: isWorkflowApiAvailable() uses GET /api/workflow/status which is public → returns true
backend auth middleware requires Admin for mutating /api/* (except public list including /api/security/events)
NO session-level circuit breaker — next local persist retries the write path
threat fetch wrapper counts failures/mutations → THREAT_EVENT failure_burst/mutation_burst → POST /api/security/events

notificationsGET: also teams-updated / release-updated / initial hydrate / NotificationCenter.svelte
securityEventsPOST: triggered when trackSignal counts exceed yellow thresholds (apiFailures yellow=3, api mutations yellow=12, workflow yellow=4)
15s cooldown per category:type; security API excluded from failure tracking

authContract.backend: mutating /api/* requires Admin Bearer unless public (security/events is public)
authContract.frontendWorkflow: workflowFetch only sets Content-Type; does not call getAdminAuthorizationHeader()
authContract.401meaning: genuine auth requirement incorrectly handled by treating read-availability as write-availability and retrying forever on each persist
authContract.expectedFallback: localStorage workflow store is fine; repeated unauthorized POSTs are NOT expected

notificationFrequency.intended: hydrate on init + relevant domain events; evaluateNotificationTriggers on workspace refresh (local trigger logic, not necessarily remote list)
notificationFrequency.actual: hydrateNotifications on every workflow-tasks-updated; Command Center refresh can cause store persists that fire that event
notificationFrequency.how1019: ≈1 GET /api/notifications?userId=user-owner-1 per hydrate; at ~1/s ≈17 min, at ~2/s ≈8.5 min, at ~5/s ≈3.4 min of Studio-open storm; 5s timer alone cannot produce 1019

threatFeedback.uploadCategoryCountZero: confirms storm is not upload/vault PUT burst
threatFeedback.canTriggerCommandCenterRefresh: indirectly via discovery/security UI listeners; primary Command Center loop is independent 5s + workflow-tasks-updated

studioVaultImpact.how: main-thread event churn + competing network (status/tasks/notifications/security) while Studio open
studioVaultImpact.mp4DnD: UNRELATED as root cause; Phase 26 probe still got ACCEPT UI during production session

minimalSurgicalFix.change: Attach getAdminAuthorizationHeader()/getAdminAuthHeaders() on POST/PUT/DELETE; map 401 to typed auth error
On missing_authorization, set writeDisabledForSession=true and stop further POSTs; do not treat GET status success as write permission
Debounce hydrateNotifications; remove or heavily throttle hydrate-on-every-workflow-tasks-updated
Debounce refreshSnapshot/refreshBrief; avoid dual 5s refreshers both syncing workflow on same events

phase27MediaVault: MAY_PROCEED for vault-specific work (DnD/upload path not caused by this storm)
recommendedNextPhase: PHASE-26.2 surgical Command Center auth+retry containment (workflow Authorization + write circuit breaker + notification hydrate debounce)
